one_line: Inside-sales CRM with a full developer platform: REST API, OAuth2, webhooks/event log, and a first-party MCP server.
auth_notes: API keys for scripts/server integrations; OAuth2 for user-facing integrations (OAuth app creation documented). Community client libraries for Python, Node.js, Ruby, PHP, Go.
self_serve_notes: Paid plans required for API access; free trial available for evaluation. API keys are self-serve within an active account.

api_surface.breadth_estimate: Leads, contacts, activities, opportunities, sequences, bulk actions, email/SMS, reporting metrics
api_surface.webhook_note: Real-time event notifications plus a 30-day event log for syncing changes out

existing_mcp.note: Close ships its own MCP server ('Model Context Protocol for AI agents' listed in the developer platform nav); community servers also exist

evidence.note: Fetched developer platform page confirmed REST API, API keys + OAuth2, webhooks/event log, MCP server, and integration directory

agent_notes: Fully confirmed from fetched text including first-party MCP server. Only friction is the paid plan requirement.
